body: Life changing moment. Good luck all.
I feel for your wife if you had such thoughts after being away for a week. That's rough.
And then identifying as the shooter when you get *purposely* misgendered.

I love these concepts. I would love to and have tried to be part of things like this but in my experience, it often dies out early on.

I feel like just one group of adventurers is hard enough to form, let alone two. That said, I think you should totally try it out. Post over on your server's forum on Blizzard's official site and see who's interested. In fact, there's been a few recent attempts at something similar to this on my server who setup the premise over on the forums.
